requirements.basis: I read my own prior requirements response/execution, the current task and effective requirements, and every actual diff hunk in five complete 60-line segments. The task and requirement IDs/summaries are unchanged; requirement status/evidence bookkeeping changed and was not used as proof of substantive adequacy. Against my independently reviewed prior frozen report, all added/deleted nonblank lines match the supplied full diff and the current report matches the author saved v2 draft. Internal TTC/SUP labels are replaced by descriptive paper or method names, with minor grammatical de-duplication. The 54 citation URLs remain identical in order, including their version suffixes; section/table locators and Appendix B model, date, split and implementation boundaries remain. These edits preserve the previously assessed mechanism-and-evidence matrix, mathematical/code/tool evidence, scaling limits and verifier constraints, distinction between training and inference, complete budget framework and worked hypothetical example, and conditional design tree including no-extra-compute outcomes. The edited cost and appendix passages retain their numbers, assumptions, caveats and substantive reasoning. Citation labels now expose recognizable paper identities without removing locatability or adding empirical claims. The current version continues to satisfy the English report requirements; no new research, reproduction, full source reread or report edit was performed.
